response.original_title: The Next Ordinary Television TV Movie
response.overview: The chaos escalates in this second feature-length compilation film, collecting the entire six-episode run of Season 2. As teenage triplets Leo, Lucy, and newly joined Liam navigate their late-night movie marathon, the parodies hit harder, the pop-culture satire gets weirder, and internet trends are pushed to their absolute limits. Featuring the arrival of Peanut’s girlfriend Iris, a high-stakes fast-food special, and a surge of unpredictable new sketches, The Next Ordinary Television TV Movie delivers non-stop, high-velocity comedy from start to finish.
response.tagline: More chaos. More parodies. Now with 33% more triplets.
response.title: The Next Ordinary Television TV Movie
